channel.title: The Venus Journal | Path to Venus
channel.description: Venus science, space exploration, and future habitats.

item.title: Could Humans Really Live in the Clouds of Venus?
item.description: Explore the science behind floating habitats on Venus, why the cloud layer is more inviting than the surface, and the engineering obstacles still ahead.

item.title: Why Is a Day on Venus Longer Than a Year?
item.description: A Venus rotation takes about 243 Earth days while its orbit takes about 225. Discover why a sunrise-to-sunrise day is different.

item.title: How Much Does It Cost to Send a Spacecraft to Venus?
item.description: From a small flyby probe to a sophisticated Venus lander, the budget depends on mission goals, instruments, launch, communications, and testing.

item.title: Venus vs. Mars: Which Is Better for Human Settlement?
item.description: Compare Venus cloud habitats with Mars surface bases: gravity, atmospheric pressure, radiation, resources, engineering, and unanswered questions.

item.title: What Would Happen If You Landed on Venus?
item.description: Follow a spacecraft from Venus atmosphere entry to the blistering surface, and discover how long Soviet Venera landers managed to operate.

item.title: Could We Build Floating Cities Above Venus?
item.description: A realistic look at Venus aerostat cities: why balloons could float, how settlement modules might work, and what science must prove first.
